from.place: Noetherian approximation proof step: descent of the bounded finitely presented flat complex and proper support (Tags 01ZR, 05LY, 081G and Cohomology Lemma 30.26.7)

title: Descent of a flat complex with proper support
statement: Let R be a filtered colimit of Noetherian rings R_i, let X_i be a finitely presented R_i-scheme [def-pc-scheme] whose base change to R is X, and let G^\bullet be a bounded complex of finitely presented O_X-modules flat over Spec(R) [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base], with every term having support proper over Spec(R) [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. Then, after increasing i, there is a bounded complex G_i^\bullet of finitely presented O_{X_i}-modules flat over Spec(R_i), with every term having support proper over Spec(R_i), together with an isomorphism from its base change to G^\bullet.
